action_items: P3 (testability) — dashboard.tsx:400 and :626 use `data-testid` prop only on the TouchableOpacity for pending-followup cards; react-native-web does not forward custom `data-testid` unless `testID` is also present. Add `testID={`sup-pending-followup-${proc.id}`}` / `testID={`inc-pending-followup-${proc.id}`}` so E2E selectors work. Not blocking (text selectors already work).

P3 (a11y) — On the follow-up form the DoneDatePicker component leaks internal calendar testIDs prefixed with 'undefined.' (e.g. 'undefined.day_2026-07-28'). Likely the DoneDatePicker instance is being rendered without a `testID` prop for the react-native-calendars child, causing the calendar library to emit `undefined.` prefixed testids. Cosmetic but pollutes the DOM.

P4 (RN-Web) — Alert.alert for baseline-probing info button (submit-phase4-step2/[id].tsx:526) and follow-up form incomplete-submit validation are invisible on web builds. Consider a custom modal for parity with mobile.
critical_code_review_comments: FollowUpSection.tsx:135-200 — clean implementation. testID props correctly applied on section, toggles, approve/reject buttons, reject reason input, and start button. Reject modal uses controlled state and only fires doReject on Confirm.

components/FollowUpSection.tsx — Approve/Reject buttons are conditionally rendered based on `canApprove(fu)` (role + status gating) — verified visually: student sees no buttons, supervisor sees them only on the pending one.

app/procedures/followup/[id].tsx — 10-section layout matches spec exactly, testIDs on every section. Chips component (line 37-45) auto-generates per-option testIDs which is excellent for automated verification. Survival section rendered FIRST at line 268, Date at line 298. Overdenture section (line 485) is conditionally rendered — correct.

app/(tabs)/dashboard.tsx:400 & :626 — MISSING `testID` prop on the pending-followup TouchableOpacity; only `data-testid` is set. RN-Web will NOT propagate arbitrary HTML attributes from a TouchableOpacity — the `data-testid` prop is dropped. Text-based DOM query still works but automated selector-based tests fail. Add testID alongside for parity.

app/procedures/submit-phase4-step2/[id].tsx:520-568 — Baseline probing section correctly gated by implantPositions.length. Uses proper numeric sanitization on onChangeText. testIDs follow convention `baseline-probing-<pos>-<key>`. Good.
